from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class NetProfitData(BaseModel):
    """One reported net profit attributable to shareholders of the parent company."""
    company_name: str = Field(description="Name of the company", examples=["东阿阿胶"])
    report_period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period (e.g., '2015 Q1', '2015 Q1-Q3', '2015 Full Year')")
    net_profit: float | None = Field(description="Net profit attributable to shareholders in CNY; negative means loss")
    year_over_year_growth: str | None = Field(description="YoY growth percentage as stated in the report (e.g., '23.16%', '-121.33%'), None if not provided")
    profit_type: str | None = Field(description="Type of profit figure: 'Q1 single quarter', 'Q1-Q3 cumulative', 'Q3 single quarter', 'Full Year'")
    source_document_id: int = Field(description="The document ID that contains this data (1-13)")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    net_profit_data_points: list[NetProfitData]
